I don't have that in my memory. My summary says only that the owner's sudo password was used once for an inotify sysctl, and that he was told to rotate it. It doesn't record the file I wrote the setting to, or whether I persisted it at all. It also doesn't record the limit value. I won't guess at either.

To check, look at the sysctl config on obelisk, usually `/etc/sysctl.d/` or `/etc/sysctl.conf`, for `fs.inotify.max_user_watches`. Running `sysctl fs.inotify` shows the live values. I can dispatch a leaf to check it if you want.
